desc_en: Elevate moments of repose with the DAZ Luxury short bathrobe. Crafted from a lightweight polyester blend fabric, this piece offers an unmatched weightless sensation against the skin. The design features a secure belt closure ensuring a flawless universal fit and two practical front pockets for morning essentials. Each piece is made to order with worldwide shipping available.
desc_es: Eleve los momentos de descanso con la bata corta DAZ Luxury. Confeccionada en un tejido ligero de mezcla de poliéster, esta pieza ofrece una sensación de ligereza inigualable sobre la piel. El diseño presenta un cinturón con cierre que asegura un ajuste universal impecable y dos bolsillos delanteros funcionales para mayor comodidad matutina. Cada pieza se elabora bajo pedido y cuenta con envío a todo el mundo.
details_en:
· Lightweight polyester blend fabric
· Belt closure for universal fit
· Two front pockets
· Machine washable in cold water, gentle cycle, mild detergent
· Made to order and available with worldwide shipping
